All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
Cashier
The Cashier collects payment automatically, with no choice from the user: at most one customer per turn, the one who has been ready to pay the longest The main method is takeAction(), which takes the next table from the cashier queue and charges that table's order The cashier queue stores the table numbers of Customers that are ready to pay This class applies the rules for payment and updates the shared tables, order list and game statistics Table indexes used here are 0-based.
Chef
The Chef can only do one task per turn: Prepare an order (advances one order by one preparation unit) Wait The main method is takeAction(), which prompts the user to choose the task for the Chef to do This class applies the rules for preparing orders and updates the shared order list Order indexes used here are 0-based.
Customer
Serves as the base class for all Customers in the game It's id is basically the nth customer that spawned in Needs to have a menu array passed in when initializing Defaults satisfaction value to 100
CustomerStatus
Different states of a Customer throughout its lifecycle
GameStats
Maintains the values of: revenue, customers served, customers who paid, unhappy departures, and the total satisfaction of paid customers A single instance is shared by the Cashier, the game loop and the UI, so they all read and write from the same object The average satisfaction is calculated from paid customers only, and is null until the first customer pays.
GameUI
Console user interface for the game It purely functions as an I/O interface for other objects in the game It also serves as a filter to clean up inputs It contains no game rules The staff classes and the game loop decide what is allowed and calls the display methods All dialogue is looked up by key from messages.properties through the Messages class.
MenuItem
The MenuItem serves as both an order and a menu item The lifecycle of a MenuItem: 1.
MenuItemStatus
Different states of a MenuItem throughout its lifecycle
Messages
Looks up UI text from messages.properties and fills in the placeholders.
Regular
 
RestaurantRushApp
Entry point and turn controller for Restaurant Rush This class owns the shared game state (waiting queue, tables, orders, cashier queue and statistics) It also gives references to the Waiter, Chef, Cashier and GameUI so they all work on the same objects Each turn runs in this order: 1.
Waiter
The Waiter can only do one task per turn: Seat a customer from the queue Take a seated customer's order Serve a ready order The main method is takeAction(), which prompts the user to choose the task for the Waiter to do This class applies the rules for each task and updates the shared queue, tables and order list Table and order indexes used here are 0-based.
